semanticChecks: Systolic/diastolic are paired values within a heartbeat, not diseases high/low pressure; no new diagnostic threshold.

Pressure varies with posture/activity/emotion/illness and daily conditions. Excitement/tension/sleep loss/exercise/temperature/straining/held excretion retained; no withholding elimination for staff schedule.

Both readings and their respective contexts reported; abnormal value not dismissed after activity, and one value does not prove onset/cure. Individual plan/facility procedure controls contact/rechecking.

Persistent hypertension may be asymptomatic; actual measurement and medical-professional assessment required. Lifestyle/genetics versus secondary renal cause preserved; heart burden is not claim all heart disease causes hypertension.

Cerebral infarction versus hemorrhage including intracerebral/subarachnoid, coronary angina/infarction and arteriosclerosis wall change distinguished. Brain/eye/retina/kidney/overall vessels evaluated by medical professional without symptom-absence reassurance.
Salt/activity/medicine follow treatment/support plan; care worker cannot stop/increase/decrease medicines because person feels well. Actual values/usual changes/person words reported.
Body region/right-left based on person; head/neck/torso/limbs, eye corners/forehead/chin/neck-throat, arm/wrist/fingers/tips/palm/dorsum,ankle/toes/heel/sole versus foot dorsum retained.

Waist not whole back; buttock synonyms and affected/unaffected contrast not fixed left-right or guarantee unaffected side problem-free. Unknown pain intensity/cause not invented; urgent reporting not delayed for all questions.

Central brain/spinal cord versus peripheral information routes,12pairs cranial/31pairs spinal, sensory inward/motor outward, spinal two-way traffic/reflex retained. Region labels not individual nerve-pair names; no diagram-based symptom diagnosis.

Cerebrum/cerebellum/diencephalon/brainstem distinguished; midbrain/pons/medulla are brainstem,thalamus/hypothalamus diencephalon. Interconnection prevents single-site emotion/action simplification; no self-localized injury diagnosis.
Autonomic regulation does not require conscious per-action orders; sympathetic activity/tension versus parasympathetic rest/recovery are tendencies, not measured personal pulse/BP facts.
Peripheral vessel tone/constriction and multiple pressure factors retained; not every organ is identical opposite dual action. Anxiety observation distinct from unmeasured BP rise.

Pupil dilation/constriction is mechanism learning, not neurological examination instruction. Gut suppression/promotion and airway bronchodilation/constriction retained without all-cause simplification or drug selection.

Eccrine sweating sympathetic control remains important; parasympathetic does not directly stop sweat glands as mirror opposite. Organ-specific model limits, observed state versus guessed cause and professional consultation retained.
All question distractors translated as their actual source statements, including true but irrelevant knowledge; each rationale preserves why it does not answer this question.
